description: This Java class provides logging helper methods for different log levels, with support for conditional logging based on build configuration and dynamic tag creation.

classes.name: LogHelper
classes.description: A utility class for simplified and conditional logging in Android applications.

methods.name: makeLogTag
methods.description: Creates a log tag with a prefix, truncating if necessary.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message if in debug build.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message if in debug build.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with an exception.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Performs the actual logging based on level, message, and optional exception.
